snippet.description: In this clip, UPSC CSE Topper AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devta shares why he decided to prepare from home instead of moving to Delhi. He breaks down his pros-and-cons analysis—weighing accommodation and daily hassles against modern online study resources—to explain how aspirants can clear UPSC CSE directly from home without relocating to coaching hubs.
